data.gender_notes: Hiltner is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German words hilt, meaning battle, and nari, meaning man or warrior. The name Hiltner signifies a fighter or warrior. The name Hiltner carries the meaning “Battle warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hiltner usually hope their child will grow to embody battle warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: חילטנר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'chalal' meaning 'to cut, divide, separate, make a hole, or break through.' The name Hiltner can be interpreted as 'fighter, warrior,' which is a fitting name for someone who is strong and courageous.

in_greek.name: ἵλτνηρ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root 'hilas' meaning 'to help, aid, support, or defend.' The name Hiltner can be translated as 'helper, supporter, defender,' reflecting the idea of someone who is there to assist and protect others.

in_latin.name: Hiltnerius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root 'hilare' meaning 'cheerful, glad, merry, or joyful.' However, an alternate meaning of 'hilare' is 'fighter, warrior,' which is the meaning most closely related to the name Hiltner. Thus, the name Hiltnerius can be interpreted as 'fighter, warrior.'

in_english.name: Hiltner
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old English elements 'heh' meaning 'he, heath,' and 'leon' meaning 'lion.' The name Hiltner can be interpreted as 'fighter, warrior,' reflecting the idea of someone who is strong and courageous, and is derived from the Old English elements.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hiltner was likely brought to prominence during medieval times when Christian warriors took up the name as a reminder of their battle for faith and Christendom against pagan forces. This noble moniker continued to resonate throughout history, with notable bearers such as German explorers and settlers expressing the enduring legacy of a valiant name.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Hiltner represents the unwavering commitment, courage, and perseverance of a Christian warrior. Regardless of one's circumstances or challenges, the name encourages unwavering faith and the resolution to fight spiritual battles to uphold the virtues of compassion, kindness, and love. In this way, the name Hiltner is a constant reminder of our spiritual responsibility and the power of the Christian faith to enable us to overcome adversity and champion the cause of God.
